correctness.rationale: Proof partitions by common-entry valuation; primitive Smith form gives image length, and the primitive trace–determinant map is locally two-coordinate surjective along nonzero residue-square-zero matrices. Deep shells contribute the primitive rank polynomial, shallow shells contribute explicit determinant-valuation fibers. All terms are disjoint, account for every matrix, and yield independent total and rational-series cross-checks. Exactly nineteen exhaustive cases passed, including mixed characteristic; finite tests are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: Inspected literature treats unrestricted Smith-shape counts, trace-zero counts, and Drazin-index nilpotency totals, none seen to imply the joint \(X^2=0\) and image-length polynomial across all finite chain-ring lengths. Historical overlap with established length-two rank refinements and a length-four matrix factor was restricted to those specializations. Earlier aggregate nilpotent counts may contain the unrefined corollary, whose independent priority is not claimed; full rank polynomial is the assessed contribution. A cited inaccessible historical text remains a priority risk.
